name: Sentry
description: Sentry is an error monitoring and observability platform that tracks errors and performance issues across every language, framework, and library, giving developers structured data and AI-assisted tools to debug faster.
best_for: Ranges from solo developers on small projects (free Developer plan) to growing teams (Team plan) and large enterprises needing advanced debugging (Business/Enterprise plans), across web, mobile, and game development.
features: Error monitoring across dozens of languages and frameworks (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, and more)
Session Replay for reproducing what a user did before an error
Distributed tracing and application performance monitoring
Application profiling to pinpoint slow code paths
Cron and uptime monitoring for scheduled jobs and endpoints
AI-powered debugging tools (Seer, Autofix, AI Code Review)
Log aggregation and real user monitoring

alternatives.name: Datadog
alternatives.description: An AI-powered observability and security platform covering infrastructure, applications, logs, and user experience.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations needing unified monitoring across complex, distributed cloud systems.

alternatives.name: Snyk
alternatives.description: A developer security platform for finding and fixing vulnerabilities in code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure as code.
alternatives.best_for: Engineering teams that want security issues surfaced alongside their development workflow.
